name: UI Watchlists RC Gate

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main" ]
    paths:
      - 'tldw_Server_API/app/api/v1/endpoints/media/ingest_jobs.py'
      - 'tldw_Server_API/app/core/Jobs/manager.py'
      - 'tldw_Server_API/tests/MediaIngestion_NEW/**'
      - 'e2e/workflows/media-ingest.spec.ts'
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main" ]
    paths:
      - 'tldw_Server_API/app/api/v1/endpoints/media/ingest_jobs.py'
      - 'tldw_Server_API/app/core/Jobs/manager.py'
      - 'tldw_Server_API/tests/MediaIngestion_NEW/**'
      - 'e2e/workflows/media-ingest.spec.ts'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  cancel-duplicate-runs:
    name: Cancel Duplicate Runs
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.12.1
        with:
          access_token: ${{ github.token }}

  lint-security:
    name: Security Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install bandit

      - name: Run Bandit
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate || echo "No virtual environment found"
          python -m bandit -r tldw_Server_API/app/api/v1/endpoints/media/ingest_jobs.py tldw_Server_API/app/core/Jobs/manager.py -f json -o /tmp/bandit_quick_ingest_phase2.json
          cat /tmp/bandit_quick_ingest_phase2.json

  unit-tests:
    name: Unit Tests
    needs: [lint-security]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run Unit Tests
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest -q tldw_Server_API/tests/MediaIngestion_NEW/unit/test_ingest_jobs_batch_lookup.py

  integration-tests:
    name: Integration Tests
    needs: [unit-tests]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run Integration Tests
        run: |
          source .venv/bin/activate
          python -m pytest -q tldw_Server_API/tests/MediaIngestion_NEW/integration/test_ingest_jobs_batch_cancel.py tldw_Server_API/tests/MediaIngestion_NEW/integration/test_ingest_jobs_events_stream.py

  e2e-tests:
    name: E2E Tests
    needs: [integration-tests]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      TLDW_E2E_SERVER_URL: 127.0.0.1:8000
      TLDW_E2E_API_KEY: THIS-IS-A-SECURE-KEY-123-FAKE-KEY
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Playwright
        run: |
          npm install -g bun
          bun install

      - name: Run E2E Tests
        run: |
          bunx playwright test e2e/workflows/media-ingest.spec.ts --grep "should cancel quick ingest mid-process with confirmation" --reporter=line

  all-green:
    name: All Green
    needs: [e2e-tests]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: re-actors/alls-green@release/v1
        with:
          jobs: "cancel-duplicate-runs,lint-security,unit-tests,integration-tests,e2e-tests"
          allowed-failures: ""

  notify-slack:
    name: Notify Slack
    needs: [all-green]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: act10ns/slack@44541246747a30eb3102d87f7a4cc5471b0ffb7d
        with:
          webhook-url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          status: ${{ job.status }}
          message: "UI Watchlists RC Gate workflow completed for ${{ github.sha }}"
